runs.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN adt.nm = 'Home' THEN be.bsns_entt_id END) AS home_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN adt.nm = 'Shipping' THEN be.bsns_entt_id END) AS shipping_count FROM biz_ent AS be JOIN biz_addr AS ba ON be.bsns_entt_id = ba.ref1 JOIN addr_typ AS adt ON ba.ref2 = adt.addr_typ_id WHERE adt.nm IN ('Home', 'Shipping')

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ba.ref1) FROM biz_addr ba JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id WHERE at.nm = 'Home') AS home_address_business_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ba.ref1) FROM biz_addr ba JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id WHERE at.nm = 'Shipping') AS shipping_address_business_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_address_businesses, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_address_businesses FROM biz_addr ba JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1) FROM emp JOIN prsn ON prsn.ref1 = emp.ref1 JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp_dept_hist.ref3 = emp.ref1 JOIN dept ON dept.dprt_id = emp_dept_hist.ref2 WHERE prsn.eml_prmt = 0 AND dept.nm = 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1) AS employee_count
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist h ON h.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = h.ref2
WHERE p.eml_prmt = 0
  AND d.nm = 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1)
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3
JOIN dept ON emp_dept_hist.ref2 = dept.dprt_id
WHERE prsn.eml_prmt = 0
AND dept.nm = 'Engineering'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT emp.ref1) FROM emp JOIN biz_cnt ON biz_cnt.ref1 = emp.ref1 JOIN cnt_typ ON biz_cnt.ref2 = cnt_typ.cntc_typ_id JOIN prsn_crd ON emp.ref1 = prsn_crd.ref1 JOIN crd ON prsn_crd.ref2 = crd.crdt_crd_id WHERE cnt_typ.nm = 'Store Contact' AND crd.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN biz_cnt bc ON bc.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN stor s ON s.ref2 = bc.ref3
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON pc.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN crd c ON c.crdt_crd_id = pc.ref2
WHERE c.crd_typ = 'Vista'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ref1) FROM prsn p JOIN prsn_crd pc ON pc.ref1 = p.ref1 JOIN crd c ON c.crdt_crd_id = pc.ref2 WHERE p.prsn_typ = 'SC' AND c.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT DISTINCT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp AS e
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept AS d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN prsn AS p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving'
  AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) = 2009
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3
JOIN dept ON emp_dept_hist.ref2 = dept.dprt_id
WHERE dept.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving'
  AND YEAR(emp.hr_dt) = 2009

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) = 2009

SELECT s.nm, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN sls_terr st ON sp.ref1 = st.trrt_id
JOIN prsn p ON sp.ref2 = p.ref1
WHERE st.nm = 'France'

SELECT s.nm, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN sls_terr st ON sp.ref1 = st.trrt_id
JOIN emp e ON sp.ref2 = e.ref1
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
WHERE st.nm = 'France'

SELECT DISTINCT stor.nm, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1
WHERE sls_terr.nm = 'France'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, t.nm
FROM stor AS s
JOIN sls_prsn AS sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN prsn AS p ON sp.ref2 = p.ref1
JOIN sls_terr AS t ON sp.ref1 = t.trrt_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm, sls_terr.nm FROM stor JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2 JOIN prsn ON prsn.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2 JOIN sls_terr ON sls_terr.trrt_id = sls_prsn.ref1 WHERE stor.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, t.nm
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref2
JOIN emp e ON sp.ref2 = e.ref1
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN sls_terr t ON sp.ref1 = t.trrt_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'
SELECT DISTINCT vnd.nm FROM vnd JOIN prod_vnd ON vnd.ref1 = prod_vnd.ref2 JOIN prod ON prod.prdc_id = prod_vnd.ref3 WHERE prod.nm LIKE 'Women''s Tights%'
SELECT DISTINCT vnd.nm FROM prod JOIN prod_vnd ON prod.prdc_id = prod_vnd.ref3 JOIN vnd ON prod_vnd.ref2 = vnd.ref1 WHERE prod.nm = 'Women''s Tights'

SELECT DISTINCT v.nm
FROM vnd AS v
JOIN prod_vnd AS pv ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2
JOIN prod AS p ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub AS ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
WHERE ps.nm = 'Tights' AND p.styl = 'W'

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm, (p.lst_prc - p.stnd_cst) AS net_profit, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, a.pstl_cd, sp.nm AS state_province, c.nm AS country_region
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref3
JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1
JOIN biz_addr ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1
JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id
JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id
JOIN cnty c ON sp.ref2 = c.cntr_rgn_cd
WHERE p.prdc_id = 843

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm AS average_lead_time, (pv.lst_rcpt_cst - pv.stnd_prc) AS profit_on_net, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, a.pstl_cd, sp.nm AS state_province, c.nm AS country FROM prod_vnd AS pv JOIN vnd AS v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 JOIN biz_addr AS ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1 JOIN addr AS a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id LEFT JOIN st_prv AS sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id LEFT JOIN cnty AS c ON sp.ref2 = c.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE pv.ref3 = 843

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm AS average_lead_time, (pv.lst_rcpt_cst - pv.stnd_prc) AS profit_on_net, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, sp.nm AS state_province, a.pstl_cd, c.nm AS country_region FROM prod_vnd pv JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 JOIN biz_addr ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1 JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id JOIN cnty c ON sp.ref2 = c.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE pv.ref3 = 843

SELECT emp.jb_ttl, dept.nm
FROM emp
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp_dept_hist.ref3 = emp.ref1
JOIN dept ON dept.dprt_id = emp_dept_hist.ref2
WHERE emp_dept_hist.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY emp.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.jb_ttl, d.nm
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.jb_ttl, d.nm
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.prdc_id)
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
JOIN spcl_prod sp ON p.prdc_id = sp.ref1
JOIN spcl_offr so ON sp.ref2 = so.spcl_offr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Clothing'
  AND so.dscr = 'LL Road Frame Sale'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.prdc_id) AS product_count
FROM spcl_offr o
JOIN spcl_prod sp ON o.spcl_offr_id = sp.ref2
JOIN prod p ON sp.ref1 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub s ON p.ref2 = s.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat c ON s.ref1 = c.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE o.dscr = 'LL Road Frame Sale'
  AND c.nm = 'Clothing'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.prdc_id)
FROM spcl_offr o
JOIN spcl_prod sp ON sp.ref2 = o.spcl_offr_id
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = sp.ref1
JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.prdc_sbct_id = p.ref2
JOIN prod_cat pc ON pc.prdc_ctgr_id = ps.ref1
WHERE o.dscr = 'LL Road Frame Sale'
  AND pc.nm = 'Clothing'

SELECT d.nm, AVG(eph.rt) AS average_hourly_payrate
FROM emp_pay_hist eph
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON eph.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE eph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
    WHERE eph2.ref1 = eph.ref1
)
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

SELECT d.nm AS department, AVG(eph.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM dept d
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN (
  SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_rt_chng_dt
  FROM emp_pay_hist
  GROUP BY ref1
) latest ON latest.ref1 = eph.ref1 AND latest.max_rt_chng_dt = eph.rt_chng_dt
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH latest_pay AS (
  SELECT ref1, rt
  FROM (
    SELECT ref1, rt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC, mdfd_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_dept AS (
  SELECT ref3, ref2
  FROM (
    SELECT ref3, ref2,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref3 ORDER BY strt_dt DESC, mdfd_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_dept_hist
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT d.nm, AVG(lp.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM latest_pay lp
JOIN latest_dept ld ON lp.ref1 = ld.ref3
JOIN dept d ON ld.ref2 = d.dprt_id
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS comp_id, 1 AS assembly_level
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.assembly_level + 1
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.comp_id
)
SELECT p.nm AS component_name, bt.assembly_level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON bt.comp_id = p.prdc_id
ORDER BY bt.assembly_level, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
  FROM prod AS p
  JOIN bom AS b ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, bt.lvl + 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom_tree AS bt
  JOIN bom AS b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm AS component_name, bt.lvl AS level
FROM bom_tree AS bt
JOIN prod AS p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT p.prdc_id AS component_id, 0 AS lvl
  FROM prod p
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
)
SELECT p.nm AS component_name, bt.lvl AS assembly_level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
WHERE bt.lvl > 0
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.pr_assm_qty AS qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty * bt.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
)
SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_components
FROM bom_tree

WITH RECURSIVE component_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  WHERE b.ref3 IN (
    SELECT p.prdc_id
    FROM prod p
    WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN component_tree ct ON b.ref3 = ct.component_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM component_tree

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_components
FROM bom_tree
SELECT MAX(bm.bm_lvl) AS deepest_assembly_level FROM bom bm JOIN prod p ON bm.ref3 = p.prdc_id WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT p.prdc_id AS product_id, 0 AS lvl
  FROM prod p
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.product_id
)
SELECT MAX(lvl) AS deepest_assembly_level
FROM bom_tree

WITH RECURSIVE bom_lvl AS (
  SELECT p.prdc_id, 0 AS lvl
  FROM prod p
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bl.lvl + 1
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_lvl bl ON b.ref3 = bl.prdc_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT MAX(lvl) AS deepest_assembly_level
FROM bom_lvl

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.pr_assm_qty AS qty, p.stnd_cst AS standard_cost
    FROM bom b
    JOIN prod p ON b.ref2 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE b.ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty * c.qty, p.stnd_cst
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_cte c ON b.ref3 = c.component_id
    JOIN prod p ON b.ref2 = p.prdc_id
)
SELECT SUM(c.qty * c.standard_cost) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_cte c

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree (component_id, qty) AS (
  SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM prod p
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(bt.qty * p.stnd_cst) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree (comp_id, qty) AS (
  SELECT b.ref2, b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM prod p
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.comp_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT SUM(p.stnd_cst * bt.qty) AS total_standard_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.comp_id

WITH RECURSIVE product_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref2
  WHERE p.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
  UNION
  SELECT b.ref3
  FROM bom b
  JOIN product_tree pt ON pt.prdc_id = b.ref2
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM product_tree pt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = pt.prdc_id

WITH RECURSIVE prod_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref3 AS prdc_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref2
  WHERE p.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT b.ref3
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod_tree pt ON pt.prdc_id = b.ref2
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_tree pt ON pt.prdc_id = p.prdc_id

WITH RECURSIVE product_usage AS (
  SELECT p.prdc_id AS component_id
  FROM prod p
  WHERE p.nm = 'Adjustable Race'
  UNION
  SELECT b.ref3 AS component_id
  FROM bom b
  JOIN product_usage pu ON b.ref2 = pu.component_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm
FROM product_usage pu
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = pu.component_id
WHERE p.nm <> 'Adjustable Race'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id)
FROM cust c
JOIN so_hdr so ON c.cstm_id = so.ref8
WHERE YEAR(so.ordr_dt) = 2013
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref8) FROM so_hdr WHERE ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref8) FROM so_hdr WHERE ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, COALESCE(SUM(sod.ordr_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_sold, COALESCE(SUM(sod.ln_ttl), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
LEFT JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
LEFT JOIN so_dtl sod ON sod.ref2 = p.prdc_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, COALESCE(SUM(sd.ordr_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_sold, COALESCE(SUM(sd.ln_ttl), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
LEFT JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
LEFT JOIN so_dtl sd ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, COALESCE(SUM(sd.ordr_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_sold, COALESCE(SUM(sd.ln_ttl), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
LEFT JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
LEFT JOIN so_dtl sd ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust.cstm_id) FROM cust JOIN prsn_crd ON cust.ref3 = prsn_crd.ref1 JOIN so_hdr ON cust.cstm_id = so_hdr.ref8 WHERE YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id) AS customer_count
FROM cust c
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON pc.ref1 = c.ref3
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sh.ref8 = c.cstm_id
WHERE sh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND sh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id) AS customer_count
FROM cust c
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON pc.ref1 = c.ref3
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sh.ref8 = c.cstm_id
WHERE sh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND sh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so_hdr.sls_ordr_id) FROM so_hdr JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id JOIN biz_addr ON biz_addr.ref1 = COALESCE(cust.ref3, cust.ref1) JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id JOIN cnty ON st_prv.ref2 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013 AND cnty.nm = 'Canada'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sh.sls_ordr_id) AS order_count
FROM so_hdr sh
JOIN cust c ON sh.ref8 = c.cstm_id
JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = COALESCE(c.ref3, c.ref1)
JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id
JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id
JOIN cnty co ON sp.ref2 = co.cntr_rgn_cd
WHERE sh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND sh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
  AND co.nm = 'Canada'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so_hdr.sls_ordr_id) AS order_count
FROM so_hdr
JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id
LEFT JOIN prsn ON cust.ref3 = prsn.ref1
LEFT JOIN stor ON cust.ref1 = stor.ref2
JOIN biz_ent ON biz_ent.bsns_entt_id = COALESCE(prsn.ref1, stor.ref2)
JOIN biz_addr ON biz_addr.ref1 = biz_ent.bsns_entt_id
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
JOIN cnty ON st_prv.ref2 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd
WHERE cnty.nm = 'Canada'
  AND so_hdr.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
  AND so_hdr.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'

SELECT p.nm
FROM prod p
WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM so_dtl d
  WHERE d.ref2 = p.prdc_id
)
SELECT p.nm FROM prod p WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM so_dtl s WHERE s.ref2 = p.prdc_id)
SELECT p.nm FROM prod p WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM so_dtl d WHERE d.ref2 = p.prdc_id)

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT stor.nm, addr.cty, st_prv.nm
FROM stor
JOIN biz_addr ON stor.ref2 = biz_addr.ref1
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
ORDER BY stor.nm

SELECT s.nm AS store_name, a.cty AS city, sp.nm AS state_province
FROM stor s
JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = s.ref2
JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref3
JOIN st_prv sp ON sp.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1
ORDER BY s.nm

SELECT s.nm AS store_name, a.cty AS city, sp.nm AS state_province
FROM stor s
JOIN biz_addr ba ON s.ref2 = ba.ref1
JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id
JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp AS e
JOIN prsn AS p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE e.ref1 IN (
    SELECT eph.ref1
    FROM emp_pay_hist AS eph
    WHERE eph.rt_chng_dt = (
        SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
        FROM emp_pay_hist AS eph2
        WHERE eph2.ref1 = eph.ref1
    )
    AND eph.rt > 50
)

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm, emp.jb_ttl
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = emp.ref1
WHERE eph.rt > 50
AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
    WHERE eph2.ref1 = emp.ref1
)

WITH ranked_pay AS (
  SELECT ref1, rt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC) AS rn
  FROM emp_pay_hist
)
SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN ranked_pay rp ON e.ref1 = rp.ref1
WHERE rp.rn = 1 AND rp.rt > 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND (
      SELECT eph.rt
      FROM emp_pay_hist eph
      WHERE eph.ref1 = e.ref1
      ORDER BY eph.rt_chng_dt DESC
      LIMIT 1
  ) > 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp AS e
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept AS d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN emp_pay_hist AS eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.strt_dt <= NOW()
  AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt > NOW())
  AND eph.rt > 20
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
      SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
      FROM emp_pay_hist AS eph2
      WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1) AS employee_count
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
      SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
      FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
      WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )
  AND eph.rt > 20

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes' AND YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub psub ON p.ref2 = psub.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pcat ON psub.ref1 = pcat.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pcat.nm = 'Bikes'
  AND sh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
  AND sh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
